name: prompt-640
image_purpose: Beauty and fashion lookbook reference emphasizing face, fabric, makeup, and expressive detail.

prompt.project_info: Create a polished 3x3 beauty editorial grid using one consistent approved adult fictional woman and a soft golden-beige studio palette.

composition_elements: Extreme close-up of lips and cheek with warm soft light.
Close-up of one expressive eye and brow.
Black-and-white close-up of chin and hand.
Soft portrait with ivory silk drape visible.
Close-up of hands interacting with fabric.
Profile beauty crop with gentle gaze.
Textural macro detail of silk and jewelry.
Final centered beauty portrait with consistent face and styling.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Large diffuse warm softbox, gentle golden-beige bounce, subtle highlights on skin and silk, calm luxury beauty atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-photorealistic editorial photography, high-resolution skin and silk texture, controlled depth of field, consistent identity across nine panels, clean 3x3 grid, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic 3x3 luxury beauty editorial grid, one consistent adult fictional woman in an ivory silk saree-inspired drape with minimal jewelry, varied close-up beauty panels featuring lips, eye, cheek, chin, hands, fabric, profile, and final portrait, soft golden-beige seamless studio, warm diffuse softbox, refined makeup, realistic skin texture, elegant calm fashion lookbook, no text, no watermark.
